title: Battery innovation and electric vehicles
text:
These 4 recent articles caught my attention in this rapidly evolving space of battery technologies and potential impact on electric cars and beyond.  The race to commercialize and scale to mass production, is fiercely competitive, and China appears to be a few steps ahead.  Next 3-5 years will see clear winners. How exciting!
